lines.text: Game Night, friends! Four events tonight, points for every one, and one champion at the end. Ha, let's play!
Lanterns up, it's Game Night! Four events, points on each, one champion under the leaves.
It's Game Night! Four events, points on every one, and the top of the tree gets crowned.
Slam Rush! Twenty seconds. Shake that rim like a branch!
Strike Storm! Hit those pads, quick as raindrops.
Trick Gauntlet! Grab a board and flow through it like a creek.
Hot Shot! Shots on goal. Thread it through the branches!
Coin Storm! Grab every coin, like a squirrel in acorn season!
Counter time! Bend like a willow, answer the jab in the window.
Go, go, go!
Wind's up, go!
Off you go!
Five seconds left!
Scamper! Five left!
Last five, move it!
That one's yours! The squirrels are cheering!
Took that event clean! Sweet as honey!
Winner! Points in the basket, keep climbing!
Ooh, nobody's catching you in these woods!
Rival takes that one. Brush off the leaves, friend.
The rival grabbed that one. Fair play.
Not this round. Keep your roots down.
A tie! Even branches, even points!
Level all the way! The forest shrugs!
Player two, hop on the branch! You're up!
Controller to player two. Your turn, friend!
Game Night champion! Top of the tree, friend, and the whole forest saw it!
Ha! You took the whole carnival! Somebody hang a lantern in the treehouse!
Champion of Game Night! Go on, soak it up. You earned every leaf.
The rival takes the carnival. Good games all night, friend. Come play again soon.
Carnival goes to the rival. You grew a lot out there. Rematch?
